ngst the lords of the Ascendant Saturn and Rahu, Rahu is associated with a planet. Therefore, Rahu is more powerful than Saturn. Therefore, counting should be done up to Rahu. Therefore, the Chara Dasha for Aries will be one year. The Dasha of other signs should be calculated in the same manner.
